summary: Model the [[ErrorData]] internal slot as a semantic brand distinct from ordinary Error-like properties.

target.notes: Object.prototype.toString surface behavior remains owned by OBJECT; this rule only defines the reusable error-brand semantic fact.

semantics.creation: installed on Error, NativeError, and AggregateError instances
semantics.ordinary_objects: objects merely having name/message are not branded
semantics.prototypes: Error.prototype and NativeError/AggregateError prototype objects are not branded
semantics.observable: used by Error.isError and Object.prototype.toString builtin tag selection
